explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/825 (Benkoski–Erdős): is there an absolute C > 0 such that every n with σ(n) > Cn is a sum of distinct proper divisors of n? The page records an affirmative solution by Larsen. The Lean statement: ∃ C > 0 such that every n with σ₁(n) > C·n has a subset s of its proper divisors summing to n (subsets give distinctness). n = 0 is excluded automatically since σ(0) = 0. Faithful.
